# observe_source_dataset (Data Source)

Fetches an existing source dataset by `id` or `label` through the `/v1/source-datasets` REST API, so other configuration can read its storage, schema type and retention without importing it. Requires the same backend flag as the `observe_source_dataset` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "observe_source_dataset" "logs" {
  label = "myapp/Logs"
}

output "logs_storage" {
  value = data.observe_source_dataset.logs.storage
}

output "logs_retention_days" {
  value = data.observe_source_dataset.logs.effective_data_retention_days
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The numeric ID of the source dataset. One of `id` or `label` must be set.
- `label` (String) The exact label of the source dataset, in `package/name` form. One of `id` or `label` must be set. Labels are unique per workspace; if more than one source dataset matches, set `id` instead.

### Read-Only

- `data_retention_days` (Number) Data retention set on the dataset, in days. `-1` means none is set and the dataset inherits the workspace retention.
- `description` (String) Description of the source dataset.
- `effective_data_retention_days` (Number) The data retention, in days, that applies to this dataset after inheritance.
- `external_write` (Boolean) Whether rows are written through Observe's Iceberg catalog instead of an Observe ingest pipeline.
- `icon_url` (String) Icon of the source dataset.
- `object_tags` (Map of String) Object tags for organizing and categorizing workspace objects. Map keys are tag names, values are comma-separated lists. Values are parsed as CSV format for proper escaping. Leading/trailing spaces are automatically trimmed, internal spaces are preserved. Values containing commas must be quoted using CSV escaping.
- `oid` (String) OID (Observe ID) for this object. This is the canonical identifier that
should be used when referring to this object in terraform manifests.
- `schema_type` (String) The signal type of the dataset, such as `Any`, `OtelLogs` or `Prometheus`.
- `storage` (String) Where the dataset's table is stored: `Native` or `Iceberg`.
- `storage_integration` (String) OID of the storage integration that holds the Iceberg table. Empty unless `storage` is `Iceberg`.
